title: AppointmentAssignmentPolicy - Metadata API
description: Represents the information about a resource assignment rule. This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

masterLabel.description: The label for the appointment assignment policy.

policyApplicableDuration.description: The frequency at which the utilization of service resources is calculated. Valid values are: Monthly ParameterBased Weekly

policyType.description: The type of appointment assignment policy. Valid value is: loadBalancing

utilizationFactor.description: Specifies the count type for the resource utilization. Valid values are: NumberOfAppointments TotalAppointmentDuration
